managed_policy_calibration.purpose: fit managed structural gross value under frozen sequential policy

revealed_development_diagnostic.purpose: falsification and diagnostics only; excluded from fitting and parameter selection

mbo_sealed_holdout.purpose: single final execution-realistic reveal after all v2.1 identities and gates pass

ohlcv_sealed_holdout.purpose: remain unread until a separately frozen final structural candidate exists

action_variant_contract.margin_comparison: best complete action variant versus second-best complete action variant
action_variant_contract.close_same_direction_variants: abstain as plan uncertainty; do not aggregate after observing outcome

managed_policy_episode.fill_rule: next completed 1m bar conservative limit execution
managed_policy_episode.unfilled_rule: a next-bar unfilled or expired approved order is a resolved enter action with 0 gross_R
managed_policy_episode.entry_plan_freeze: entry, original invalidation, targets and deadline freeze at approval
managed_policy_episode.right_censor_rule: a filled position still open at the registered window boundary is recorded but excluded from value fitting
management_policy: protect only to a later confirmed structural level and never widen risk
model_or_risk exit on next bar open
managed_policy_episode.label: approval-level realized gross_R: actual frozen-policy gross_R when filled and closed, 0R when the next-bar order is unfilled or expires
managed_policy_episode.reason_execution_cost_excluded: 2023 has no causally aligned MBO; live observed MBO cost is deducted after gross policy value

structural_score.formula: path_probability * capped_target_R - (1 - path_probability) - uncertainty_penalty - deadline_penalty - phase_penalty

fit.unit: one resolved risk-approved enter action (filled-and-closed trade or next-bar unfilled/expired order)
fit.grouping: playbook with directions pooled only because long/short symmetry is preregistered
fit.extrapolation: forbidden; an enter variant outside its playbook's observed structural-score support is unavailable
fit.insufficient_evidence_rule: sample-minimum failure or a one-level/non-distinct monotone fit makes managed value unavailable; enter variants for that playbook cannot outrank abstain

runtime_enter_utility.policy_shift_control: conservative filter only: managed value may accept or reject the exact enter variant selected by the frozen behavior policy; it cannot promote an unselected counterfactual variant
runtime_enter_utility.execution_source: causal MBO observation only for MBO validation and final reveal

pre_reveal_gates: all software tests pass after static trading-logic review
each playbook satisfies episode minima or is explicitly unavailable
calibration episode ledger conserves approved, filled, expired and closed states
gross value map is monotone and no threshold was selected on June-July PnL
2017-2026 unresolved source gaps remain excluded or repaired from authoritative source data
decision and future reveal artifacts remain separated
MBO and OHLCV sealed holdouts remain unread
